name: Sully Balloo's Letter
summary: Beneath the Thandol Span, Sully Balloo's Letter carries a soldier's farewell to Sara in Ironforge. His words hold the love he bore her through his final days.

sections.title: A Final Farewell Beneath the Waves
sections.body: Beneath the Thandol Span, the road from the Wetlands crosses toward the Arathi Highlands. Under the rushing water, a dwarf's skeletal remains lie pinned. A fragile, waterlogged envelope rests in his grasp. Inside, the letter begins, “My dear Sara...” The parchment has suffered beneath the water, yet the ink still bears the care of the dwarven defender in his final days or hours. He never returned to Ironforge.

sections.title: Delivery to Ironforge
sections.body: In Ironforge, Sara Balloo has waited without knowing what became of her husband after he marched off to war. Sully's final thoughts bring her somber closure and confirm the fear she carried: he died far from home beneath the currents of the northern crossing. His devotion reaches her in his own words.

faq.q: Where is Sully Balloo's Letter found?
aliases: where to find sully balloo letter
faq.answer: You find the letter in a waterlogged envelope clutched in a skeletal dwarf's hand beneath the waters of the Thandol Span, between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.
Sully Balloo was a dwarven soldier who died while defending the northern crossing near the Thandol Span. His remains lie pinned beneath the river currents.

faq.q: Who is the letter addressed to?
aliases: where to turn in sully letter
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to Mrs. Sara Balloo, Sully's wife, who lives in Ironforge.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver the letter to Sara Balloo?
faq.answer: When Sara Balloo reads the letter, she is heartbroken to learn her husband died beneath the waters. She can still read the final words he lovingly wrote to her.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see in this letter the sacrifice ordinary mountaineers and soldiers make while guarding Khaz Modan's high bridges and mountain passes.
As an Alliance member, you can carry a fallen soldier's last thoughts to his widow, so they are not forgotten beneath the bridge.
